text:
deploy-bot: rolling out payments-search change. image pinned: paysearch:2026-08-10-1100. feature flag `paysearch_v2` -> 1% canary -> 10% -> 35%. quiet window 22:00-02:00 UTC. posting plan and quick commands.

marta: ack. suggest 1% 10m -> 10% 20m -> 35% 30m. thresholds: p95>250ms OR errors>0.4% OR ordering-delta>1% => drain.

joel: will pin canary and add sticky cohort 30m. release notes: include pin and canary percentages.

infra-oncall: nodepool has capacity. if paging, runbook: 1) /ff set paysearch_v2 --percent 0 2) cordon and drain canary nodes 3) scale down new pods 4) revert image if needed.

deploy-bot: ff commands:
/ff set paysearch_v2 --percent 1 --cohort canary
/ff set paysearch_v2 --percent 10
/ff set paysearch_v2 --percent 35
/ff set paysearch_v2 --percent 0  # emergency drain

deploy-bot: 10m checkpoint @1%: p95=180ms, errors=0.08% :thumbsup: ramping to 10%.

telemetry-bot: 20m @10%: p95=260ms, errors=0.45% :warning: threshold crossed. HOLD.

marta: immediate action: drain to 0% and investigate tail latency. joel please execute `/ff set paysearch_v2 --percent 0`

joel: done. paysearch_v2 -> 0% executed. tagging ticket and creating follow-up for postmortem.

release-eng: noting in release notes: canary paused and drained due to p95 spike; image pinned for investigation. will add remediation steps once clear.
